scope: Same-build cooperative active PTY handover/resume and terminal stdin-status projection

nativeProof.runtime: Alchemy native workerd with native R2 and Queue bindings
nativeProof.clock: Existing request-local Effect TestClock crosses the 30-second lease; replacement uses saved clock plus 1000 ms for the original raw clock deadline
nativeProof.scopes: First Worker and its proxy are fully disposed before replacement opens the same native R2 state directory; all fixtures and runtimes have scoped cleanup
nativeProof.capture: StoredRun, ExecutionCheckpoint and HeapSnapshot decoded through owning Effect Schemas; archived heap metadata/PID handles inspected, then native restore validates and loads the retained pages
nativeProof.cooked: Native host_tty.read is pending with an unfinished canonical hel line; after parking, lo plus CR and EOF are retained; replacement returns hello plus newline, then EOF with exact single echo/output
nativeProof.raw: Native guest enables raw mode, reads r from raw and parks in a 31-second monotonic poll while aw remains unread; later control and invalid UTF-8 bytes plus EOF are delivered after restoration; fd_read and base64 output replay preserve every byte
nativeProof.family: Parent and child native handles [1,2] are retained; child ready marker appears once before parking; shared canonical terminal input and EOF complete after replacement
nativeProof.cancelled: A checkpointed pending terminal read is cancelled before replacement; new stdin writes fail 409; replacement acknowledges Queue delivery without guest reentry or receipt ETag mutation, retaining hel output and reporting logically closed stdin
nativeProof.authorization: Cross-sandbox stdin writes fail 401 while parked; original read/write/execute capability persists through replacement
nativeProof.duplicateDelivery: Stale original reservation Queue delivery is acknowledged after settlement; completed receipt ETag and byte output remain identical

regression.baseline: Three resume cases passed; cancelled case failed: stdin.status returned closed false despite cancelled receipt and 409 on append
regression.cause: The handler computed effective closure from the input head and process receipt, but status returned current.closed instead of that computed closure
regression.fix: Return the existing derived closed field, matching append/close; no repair writes, record changes, new persistence owner or migration
